issue.title: Finalizer accepts the manifest template's placeholder commit message 'feat(scope): describe the completed work' verbatim
issue.description:
The finalizer's commit-decision validator accepts the manifest template's placeholder commit message unchanged. When an agent builds its declaration from `manifest_template` and forgets to overwrite `message`, the host commits with the literal subject `feat(scope): describe the completed work`.

Root cause: `manifest_template()` (src/sase/finalizers/declaration_manifest.py:132) seeds every commit decision with `"message": "feat(scope): describe the completed work"`. `_validate_commit_decision()` (same file, ~line 476) checks only that the message is nonblank, at most 4000 bytes, and a valid Conventional Commit via `check_commit_message()`. The placeholder is a valid Conventional Commit, so it passes `sase final submit`, and the host finalizer commits it.

Three commits on master carry the placeholder subject:
- 1c4ebe76a (2026-09-22, agent sase-16j.1, 12 files / +2249)
- 1230ed8da (2026-09-23, agent sase-16n.11.7.3, 19 files / +477)
- ea130c678 (2026-09-25, agent sase-17m.5.1.6.3, 75 files)

Traced mechanism for ea130c678 (muse session 2e11749d-ab75-40cd-964d-32fcde788648, line 7173): the agent wrote a real 638-byte message into a `sase final prepare` wrapper. prepare was refused by the sase-17u sidecar blocker, so the agent fell back to `sase final submit`. It rebuilt the manifest from `ctx['manifest_template']`, set only `bead_action='close'`, and never copied its message over. Submit accepted it (final_submission_attempts.jsonl: code=accepted). The earlier two commits' mechanisms were not traced.

Fix direction: make the validator reject the exact template placeholder with a clear error, for example code `commit_message_placeholder` and a message telling the agent to describe the work. Apply the same check on the `sase final prepare` path. Alternatively, change the template value to something that cannot pass Conventional Commit validation, such as `<type>(<scope>): <describe the completed work>`. Add a regression test in the finalizer declaration tests.

task_type_fields.impact: Agent commits land on master with a meaningless subject and no description of the change, which destroys git-log and changelog value. The raw-submit fallback that agents use when 'sase final prepare' is blocked (see sase-17u) makes this likely.
task_type_fields.repro: Run 'sase final context -f json' in an agent turn with a dirty repo, take manifest_template, set bead_action to close without touching message, and run 'sase final submit'. It is accepted and the host commits 'feat(scope): describe the completed work'. Observed on master: 1c4ebe76a, 1230ed8da, ea130c678.

payload.description: The sase-17u sidecar dirt blocks 'sase final prepare', which pushes agents onto the raw 'sase final submit' fallback where the placeholder message slipped through
